title: Nostr-first multi-registry package repository control-plane
scope_phase: Item 1: package domain, config, projection repository, migration, and PSTF foundation only
description: Bahia will manage package repositories and package artifact publication/promotion as signed Nostr-owned desired state, with backend adapters storing and serving bytes and PostgreSQL used only as a projection/cache for queries, idempotency, and recovery. This phase establishes the stable domain/config/repository foundation for later reactor, MCP, CLI, and backend adapter work.
in_scope: First-class package formats: npm, pypi, conan, deb, rpm, pub, go_modules, gradle
First-class backend types: nexus, pulp, filesystem_mock
Config-driven backend registration with validation and secret references instead of inline secret values
Domain models for repositories, artifacts, publication/promotion state, policy decisions, and Nostr request intents
PostgreSQL projection/cache interfaces and implementation for package repositories, artifacts, publications, and idempotent Nostr request intents
Additive migration for package projection/cache tables
out_of_scope_for_this_phase: Package byte upload or source_url fetching
architectural_constraints: Nostr events remain the source of truth for desired package state; DB tables added here are projections/caches only.
No polling, request/response, or REST CRUD path is introduced by this foundation.
Backend credentials are represented only by secret references and must be resolved by a later secrets layer.
Projection upserts are stale-write-safe using last_event_created_at plus last_event_id ordering.

design_tradeoffs.decision: Use the user-requested package formats as first-class domain and migration values now instead of generic-only.
design_tradeoffs.reason: The user brief explicitly required npm, pypi, conan, deb, rpm, pub, go modules, and gradle to be preserved in this phase. Ecosystem-specific behavior remains deferred.

design_tradeoffs.decision: Expose auth_secret_ref, tls_secret_ref, and secret_refs rather than username/password/token config fields.
design_tradeoffs.reason: The brief requires secrets by reference, not inline secret values.
